Paragraph: That righteous Sugreeva desires friendship with you two; know me as his minister, the son of the Wind-god. I had to come here from Mt. Rishyamuka in an ascetic's disguise only to appease Sugreeva, and I can go by my will and wear any guise as I wish.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman explains the purpose of his mission - to establish a friendship/alliance between Sugreeva and the princes.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Proposes alliance openly, explaining his role, motives, and abilities transparently.
Outcome/Resolution: The proposal of friendship (sakhya) is placed before Rama and Lakshmana.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Relationship Challenges (Family): Seeking allies amid familial conflict with Vali

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman initiates sakhya, sacred friendship, as a bridge to resolve Sugreeva's familial injustice.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Illustrates proactive relationship-building and coalition-seeking as an adaptive response to interpersonal/familial conflict.
